verdict.rationale: The only published coverage figure is that Plaid's European Payments suite reaches "18 European markets". Community comments add that Plaid uses PSD2/Open Banking in Europe and has issues with some US banks (Wells Fargo, Bank of America) when 2FA is enabled. Nothing in the pack gives an institution count or a full geography list a founder could check against where their users bank. Missing for 10: total institution-count figures, a full country/region coverage list across all products, a per-institution coverage lookup or institution-search documentation, and independent corroboration of coverage claims.
